About AllCloud 
 AllCloud is a leader in amplifying organizations’ cloud potential through AI. With a track record of hundreds of successful migrations and implementations across AWS and Salesforce, AllCloud has developed strategies and solutions that enable businesses of all sizes to remain at the forefront of innovation.
 AllCloud is a leader in AI-led professional and managed services. As an AWS Premier and audited managed services Partner, and Salesforce Consulting partner, AllCloud provides comprehensive AI-led cloud journey support, from initial migration to ongoing management through our Engage Managed Services. Our expertise ensures that clients remain aligned with ecosystem best practices while focusing on their core business growth.
 AllCloud serves clients across the globe with offices in EMEA and North America. www.allcloud.io
 Job Summary 
 AllCloud is looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer. The primary role of the Senior DevOps Engineer is to build and deploy complex cloud environments for customers using innovative automation tools and cutting-edge technologies. As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you will be responsible for setting up, maintaining, and evolving the AWS cloud architecture, as well as for supporting infrastructure monitoring and alerting, issues troubleshooting, and developing required automation for our customers.
 How You'll Make Your Mark: 
Design and implement tailor-made cloud and hybrid network architectures
Deployment of advanced services and multi-VPC/hybrid networking solutions (Transit Gateways, VPNs, Direct Connect, load balancers) on the cloud
Configure and manage network security controls (Firewalls, Security Groups, NACLs, Web Gateways, Proxies, WAF, DNS)
Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and CI/CD automation solutions
Maintain a feedback loop with the company’s customers to ensure deliveries are in accordance with the customer’s needs and expectations
Debug, troubleshoot, and fix complex technical, system, and network-layer issues
Setup and maintain large-scale monitoring, alerting, and logging solutions
 Summary of Requirements & Experience: 
3-5 years of professional IT experience in DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure, or Systems Engineering (especially with Linux, Networking, and Security)
Hands-on experience with cloud providers (e.g. AWS, GCP, Azure)
Strong understanding of core networking protocols and concepts (TCP/IP, BGP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS/SSL, NAT, CIDR subnetting, routing) and cloud networking (VPC, Transit Gateway, VPN, Direct Connect)
Experience with Security Products and network perimeter controls (Firewalls, Web Gateways, Proxies, Security Groups, NACLs)
Strong Experience in Linux administration and network troubleshooting tools (e.g. tcpdump, dig, traceroute, VPC Flow Logs)
Strong Experience with container technologies (Kubernetes, EKS, ECS, Swarm, Docker, etc.)
Familiarity with the Agile methodology
Scripting abilities in at least two of the following: Python, Go, Bash, PowerShell
Experience working in a customer-facing role
Creative troubleshooting skills and out-of-the-box thinking
Ability to learn various technologies and topics
Strong foundations with Git and gitflow methodologies
Experience with CI/CD platforms (Jenkins, CircleCI, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, CodePipeline)
Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK, Serverless framework)
Serverless architecture knowledge
 Pluses 
Experience with system monitoring platforms (Datadog, Prometheus)
Experience with centralized logging platforms (ELK)
GitOps methodology familiarity (ArgoCD, Flux)
Information security orientation
AWS Certifications (e.g. Solutions Architect, Advanced Networking Specialty) or networking certifications (CCNA)
Experience with production environments
AWS Security tooling and Best practices (Security Hub, AWS Config, WAF / Shield, etc.)
AWS Landing Zone and Multi-account strategy
CKA / CKAD certification
 Why work for us? 
 Our team inspires progress in each other and in our customers through our relentless pursuit of excellence; you will work with leaders who promote learning and personal development. We offer competitive salaries, bonus incentives, benefits, flexible hours, and mentoring. Apply now to become part of the team.
